hero.title: Logistic ecosystem
hero.description: Redesign of core customer-facing products for a large logistics platform

meta.role: Led the redesign of the service catalog and account ecosystem for a large logistics platform, covering both B2C and B2B users.
meta.scope: Discovery → User Flow Mapping → Concept Design → UX interviews → Target Flow Redesign → Metrics

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Users struggled to find the right service in a large and fragmented catalog.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We reviewed existing sections, mapped user journeys, and interviewed users.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We simplified navigation, grouped related services, and made key options easier to find.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A clearer catalog that helped users reach the right service faster.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Creating a shipment worked differently across mobile, B2C web, and B2B web.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We compared the flows and identified the steps that could be shared.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We created one structure with saved addresses, preset package sizes, and clear delivery options.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A consistent and familiar shipment flow across all platforms.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Digital services and post-office visits felt like separate experiences.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We mapped the full journey—from preparing a shipment to tracking its delivery.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We added QR access, shared notifications, tracking, and an address book.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: Users could move between online services and post offices more easily.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Separate product structures made updates slow and expensive.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We identified shared patterns and the different needs of B2C and B2B users.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We created a shared structure and reusable design patterns.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: One foundation that could support future updates across the whole ecosystem.
